[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Cherry smoothie: Blend fresh cherries, Greek yogurt, and milk for a creamy and nutritious smoothie.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Cherry salsa: Mix cherries with onions, peppers, and lime juice for a delicious salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cherry yogurt bowl: Layer yogurt with fresh cherries, sliced almonds, and honey.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Cherry chia pudding: Mix chia seeds, almond milk, and fresh cherries.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Cherry and almond energy balls: Mix chopped cherries, almond flour, dates, and coconut oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Cherry quinoa salad: Toss cooked quinoa with fresh cherries, spinach, feta cheese, and vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Cherry chicken salad: Combine shredded chicken, dried cherries, almonds, and Greek yogurt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Cherry almond granola: Mix oats, almonds, and dried cherries with honey and coconut oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Cherry smoothie bowl: Blend frozen cherries with Greek yogurt, almond milk, and vanilla extract.
